gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.67483 45.520027)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.67483 45.520027)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.028462 38.902787)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.028462 38.902787)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH
  hubers_point AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.67483 45.520027)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
  ),
  eaton_dc_point AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.028462 38.902787)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
  ),
  hubers_elevation AS (
    SELECT 
      ST_Value(r.rast, h.geom) AS elevation
    FROM 
      hubers_point h,
      public.dem_us r
    WHERE 
      ST_Intersects(r.rast, h.geom)
  ),
  eaton_dc_elevation AS (
    SELECT 
      ST_Value(r.rast, e.geom) AS elevation
    FROM 
      eaton_dc_point e,
      public.dem_us r
    WHERE 
      ST_Intersects(r.rast, e.geom)
  )
SELECT 
  (SELECT elevation FROM hubers_elevation) - (SELECT elevation FROM eaton_dc_elevation) AS elevation_difference;
